Why does destiny allow two souls to meet, only to fill their hearts with the most beautiful memories, and then condemn them to spend the rest of their lives mourning those very moments? It gives us a love so profound that it becomes a part of our soul, yet takes away the one person we wish to keep forever.
The memories never fade. They live with us every single day, in every silence, every song, every familiar place. We do not move on we simply learn to carry them. And somewhere, hidden beneath all the pain, remains one question that never stops echoing ,Will I ever meet them again?
Perhaps this is what true love is not always staying together, but living an entire lifetime with someone who never truly leaves your heart😢💔
